questions.title: Designing a RAG pipeline
questions.prompt: Design a question-answering feature over a company's internal docs using retrieval-augmented generation. Walk through ingestion and query time.
expectedConcepts: Access control filtering at retrieval time
questions.answerOutline: Two pipelines: offline indexing and online query. Emphasise permission-aware retrieval, evaluation, and handling 'no good context' honestly.
commonMistakes: Treating the model as the knowledge source
followUps: How do you detect and reduce hallucinations?
How do you handle prompt injection inside documents?
questions.rubricNotes: Security and evaluation awareness separate strong answers.

questions.title: Safe tool-using agents
questions.prompt: An LLM agent can call tools such as sending email and querying a database. What risks exist and how do you design around them?
questions.answerOutline: Treat model output as untrusted input to your system: validate tool calls, limit capabilities, require confirmation for risky actions, and log everything.
commonMistakes: Relying on the system prompt alone for security
followUps: How would MCP servers fit in, and what trust boundaries exist?
questions.rubricNotes: Look for defence in depth rather than a single control.
